description: Published Zolva agents with their return, return vs simply holding the same markets, worst drop and trade count. Paper trading only.

limit.description: How many agents to return, default 20

market.description: Only agents watching this market symbol, such as NVDA, ETH or BTC-PERP

sortBy.description: return (default, highest first), vs_holding (most ahead of holding first) or drawdown (smallest worst drop first)

venue.description: Only spot agents (tokens, long only) or only perps agents (Lighter, long or short)

name: list_agents
title: List agents
